description: World’s Slimmest 3D Curve Display 5G Smartphone : Experience the world’s slimmest 3D curved display 5G smartphone featuring a stunning 144Hz 1.5K AMOLED screen. With 4500nits ultra-bright peak brightness, enjoy unmatched clarity and smoothness in any light. World’s Lightest & Slimmest 5G Smartphone : Enjoy all-day power in style with the world’s lightest and slimmest 5G smartphone featuring a massive 5160mAh battery. Designed for those who want performance without the bulk. World’s 1st Dynamic Mood Light Design : Experience the world’s first Dynamic Mood Light Design that responds like human emotion—glowing with your vibe, mood, and moments. It’s not just a phone, it’s a reflection of you. Endurance and Durability : Pova SLIM is built for real-world endurance, backed by MIL-STD-810H military-grade toughness, and TÜV-certified 5-Year Lag-Free Fluency IP64 Dust and Splash Resistance. Whether it’s daily wear or extreme conditions, it’s designed to perform without slowing down. Ella AI with Indian Regional Language Support : Smarter, more human, and made for India—Ella AI understands your voice in your language, delivering an experience that feels truly yours.
